jobs.title: Public Safety Officer - Onsite Patrol
jobs.description: The City of Friendswood Police Department is accepting applications for a Police Officer to work onsite in Friendswood, TX. This role focuses on enforcing laws, safeguarding the community, conducting patrols, and responding to incidents in the field. This is a full-time, hourly position with pay ranging from $33.98 to $44.08 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications. The deadline to apply is Aug 11, 2026.

jobs.title: Lead Transportation Security Officer - Airport Leader
jobs.description:
Airport Security Careers is seeking individuals for Lead and Supervisory Transportation Security Officer roles at airports serving Friendswood, TX and nationwide. The positions offer leadership responsibilities within airport security operations and opportunities to advance.

Starting pay ranges from $25.00 to $50.00 per hour, with annual compensation between $52,000 and $80,000+, and comprehensive benefits including insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.
